messages:
support-sara: Heads-up: Acme reporting 503s since ~10:03 UTC on hosted inference. CS on call. Error rate ~12% and p95 latency up. Logs show upstream infer worker exits.

jordan: Any logs or traces?

support-sara: Paste of recent logs:
```
infer-runner[1423]: segfault (signal 11) at 0x7ff... backtrace: ...
nvml: GPU 0 OOM while allocating 600MB
containerd: task exited with status 137
```

maria: Is the spike aligned with a model swap or autoscale event?

support-sara: Yes — autoscaler triggered a hot swap to model v2-quant at 10:02:41, failures started ~10:03:10.

eng-ml-lee: Sounds like quantized kernel/regression + sudden concurrency increase. Any repro steps from CS?

support-sara: CS repro steps: fire 400 qps of embed calls with seq_len=2048 routed to hosted/model-v2; OOMs after ~30s, then segfault.

ash: Were fallbacks triggered (model variants / routing)? Any auth failures too?

ops-bot: kube: Node gpu-pool-07 restart-loop detected — 24 restarts in 5m. Eviction events reported.

jordan: Can we pull coredump + nvcrash + dmesg from that node? Where are artifacts stored?

maria: I'm collecting coredumps + NVML logs and attaching to INF-7892 (Jira). Uploading to s3://redwood-debug/8390012345/

support-sara: Interim mitigation advised to customer: throttle to 50 qps, pin to model v1-rc, and disable autoswap for that pool. CS told Acme to expect partial failures until rollback.

eng-ml-lee: Short-term action: rollback the canary to v1 and set batch_size max=64; disable KV prefetch for that job. Long-term: investigate attention kernel change in quant pipeline.

ash: I'll block auto-swap on gpu-pool-07 and roll back the model. Scheduling hotfix now.

support-sara: Billing impact: customer saw retry-related token billing spike — pinging @finance to review and pause anomaly charges.

jordan: Assigned to eng-ml-lee for triage and PR. Please post minimal repro script and results in INF-7892.

eng-ml-lee: Taking it. Will post repro script + run repro in staging with metrics. ETA 2h.

support-sara: Thanks — CS will keep customer updated. I'll update this thread with artifacts and next steps.
